title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop starting with the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.005, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.005, 0.0) to (0.005, 0.0025), then draw the first arc from (0.005, 0.0025) to (0.0025, 0.005) with a midpoint at (0.0032, 0.0032). Follow this with the third line from (0.0025, 0.005) to (0.0, 0.005), and complete the loop with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.005) back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.005. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting part has a length of approximately 0.00495 units, a width of approximately 0.00495 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.005, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.005, 0.0025) \
     .threePointArc((0.0032, 0.0032), (0.0025, 0.005)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.005) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
